subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “A map may look fixed, but it is often a picture of power at one moment.”?
options: Students compared old maps with current ones.
They compared old pages with current ones.
Students compared old tools with modern ones and felt grateful, but also thoughtful.
Students compared it with modern digital scales.
